research_notes: If the close succeeds but state update is delayed, the next invocation must prefer close evidence over stale state/current.
This is why SOURCE_OF_TRUTH includes latest durable runtime evidence in addition to state.
A reconciliation step can then update state without rerunning the completed probe.
This avoids duplicate experimental work and preserves append-only history.
The current sample's transaction order is designed for that recovery path.
No result is asserted until close evidence exists.
